fixture_name: A9 Ballinluig SB signage/VRS-adjacent visibility — real UK Stage 1&2 RSA (Transport Scotland OGL release)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Reduced forward visibility on a slip-road approach curve combined with constrained verge space is a genuine collision-risk issue affecting drivers and pedestrians, and converting the accepted remediation duty into an evidenced handover condition adds real closure value.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal claim (curve-plus-vegetation reducing forward visibility with a required cut-back for pedestrian passage) is directly anchored by the verbatim EV-UK-025 quote recording the problem and the agreed 'Vegetation clearance will be extended' action.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly typed as a safety_concern under GG 119 Stage 1 semantics; it keeps the safety issue and its remediation verification distinct and never drifts into a design-standard compliance question.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable—deliver and evidence the extended clearance across the logged locations, then confirm post-clearance driver sight lines and unobstructed pedestrian passage before handover—and viable since it operationalises an already-agreed action.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians are explicitly listed as affected road users, the scenario confirms VRU scope, and the recommendation's success criterion includes unobstructed pedestrian passage, so VRU impacts are squarely considered.

justifications.substance: Observed sight-line obstruction at a high-speed off-slip terminus undermining driver awareness of the slowing requirement is a genuine, scheme-relevant safety issue, and tying acceptance to restored driver awareness adds real value beyond hardware installation.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal claim is backed by a verbatim quote from EV-UK-025 ('Vegetation affects views to end of slip road, reducing driver awareness of requirement to slow'), fully satisfying the quote-required threshold for a top score.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly raised as a safety_concern within GG 119 Stage 1 semantics, with no blending into compliance questions, and the normative framing stays within the audit's remit.
justifications.recommendation_quality: The recommendation is concrete and testable — post-clearance drive-through at design speed verifying early visibility of the terminus, recorded in the handover file alongside the RSA action — making it specific, actionable and viable.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRUs are not plausibly exposed on the off-slip carriageway and the finding explicitly scopes road users to vehicle occupants, earning the acknowledgment credit.
